issues.detail: canoes (flap-track fairings) are inside-out: inward normals and inverted winding (regression since w8)
issues.problem: In w8 the section floors became `0.03 * Math.min(1, rw * 5)` / `0.04 * Math.min(1, rd * 5)`. The first canoe section (t = 0, rise = sin 0 = 0) is now a zero-size ring: all its points sit on the section centre. gLoft (02_geo.js:384-389) decides whether to flip normals and winding by summing n.(p - centre) over ring 0 only. That sum is now 0, so it never flips, and every canoe comes out inside-out. Probe (buildExterior(null), canoe lofts at 11_exterior.js:349): 240 of 274 vertices per canoe have inward normals on all 8 canoes. Example at s 8.4: vertex p.y -1.28 (bottom of the pod) has n.y +1.00 and gets the 1.0 'top' bake, while vertex p.y -0.45 (top, at the wing) has n.y -1.00 and gets the 0.18 'belly' bake. Culling is on (01_gl.js:17), so the outside faces are culled and the viewer sees the inside of the far wall. This is exactly what three rounds of tone complaints were describing. The pods read as flat grey slabs with a black top edge and a white lower rim (w26K, c_canoe_side), and as charcoal teeth from the A side (w19A). r7 (pre-w8) canoes read as solid lit pods in the same view (ratA10/w26K_r7_vs_r10.png). The photos show solid white pods with a lit top and a darker lower flank (_7250, _7282, KN46).
issues.fix: 11_exterior.js canoe loop (~l.343): keep ring 0 non-degenerate, e.g. `const rise = Math.max(0.06, Math.sin((Math.min(t, 0.22) / 0.22) * Math.PI / 2));`. The front cap then closes it. Belt and braces: after `B.add(gLoft(secs, 3), ...)`, check the orientation and flip normals and winding if it is inward. (Or, if the shared-file owner agrees, change gLoft's test to use the middle ring: `const j0 = secs.length >> 1` and offset k by j0 * n.) Then revert the w8/w9 tone hacks that were tuned against the inverted mesh: the bake back to about top 1 / flank 0.8 / belly 0.5, e.g. `0.5 + 0.3 * smooth(-0.8, 0, n[1]) + 0.2 * smooth(0.1, 0.4, n[1])`. Re-render w19A/w26K/c_canoe_side before retuning. Tell lighting that hand-offs 12 and 13 in from_exterior.md are probably moot (withdraw them until re-checked). Add a regression check in the studio test: every exterior gLoft add has sum(n.(p - c)) > 0.
